map.某发动机最大扭矩 T=250N·m、对应转速 n=4000rpm；功率 P=T·: An engine with peak torque T=250N·m at n=4000rpm gives P=T·2πn/60=250×2π×4000/60≈104.7kW; at 1kW=1.36PS that is about 142PS. If it is rated 110kW/150PS, peak power occurs at a higher speed than the torque peak.

map.功率和扭矩到底看哪个？: Power or torque: which one really matters?
map.扭矩决定低速爆发力与起步提速，功率决定极速与后段再加速。日常城市驾驶更感知扭矩，: Torque sets low-end punch and getaway; power sets top speed and high-speed overtaking. In town you feel torque more, while highway passing depends on power. The rev bands where each peaks matter just as much.
